voiceSummary: Ducan Infratechnologies Limited published financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the standalone net loss of 19.55 lakhs and consolidated net loss of 213.75 lakhs. JFC Finance India Limited reported a standalone net profit of 1.36 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Vikran Engineering Limited reported a standalone net profit of 7.87 lakhs and consolidated net profit of 2.75 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. All results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 5, 2026. The results are unaudited and filed with stock exchanges under SEBI regulations.

attchmntText: Ducon Infratechnologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
